en: Black‑and‑white view of a small historic European town with half‑timbered houses, a stone defensive wall on an arched bridge, and a squat tower with a steep conical roof. In the background stands a church‑like building with a baroque onion‑domed belfry. Vegetation surrounds the buildings and some laundry or hides hang on a line in the foreground. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the image side.
